title: Objectschema references Objectschema
description: The object schema refers to instances of another object schema through one or more of its properties (by id, by $ref or by embedding a list of them), recorded at the grain of the whole schema when the properties themselves are not modelled. Use schemaproperty references objectschema instead when the referring property is modelled.
x-dr-evidence: JSON Schema $ref between object definitions; a foreign-key-like id field naming another entity.
